facts.summary: Puerto Rico requires daily overtime — premium pay for hours worked beyond 8 in a day, in addition to weekly overtime. (Employees hired before Law 4-2017 may retain a higher, double-time rate.)
facts.citation: P.R. Laws Ann. tit. 29 § 271 et seq. (Ley 379-1948); Ley 4-2017
facts.sourceAgency: Puerto Rico Depto. del Trabajo y Recursos Humanos
facts.notes: VERIFY current premium rate and the pre/post-2017 hire distinction on the DTRH working-hours page (Ley 379).

facts.summary: Puerto Rico sets its own minimum wage by statute (Law 47-2021), $10.50/hour as of 2024; confirm the current 2026 figure.
facts.sourceAgency: Puerto Rico Depto. del Trabajo y Recursos Humanos
facts.notes: VERIFY 2026 figure — the Minimum Wage Review Board may have adjusted it after 2024's $10.50.

facts.summary: Puerto Rico's anti-discrimination statutes protect a broad set of characteristics, including sexual orientation and gender identity.
facts.sourceAgency: Puerto Rico Depto. del Trabajo y Recursos Humanos
facts.notes: VERIFY the full list and statute cites on the DTRH site.

facts.summary: Puerto Rico is not fully at-will: employees dismissed without just cause are entitled to statutory severance (the 'mesada'), with the amount based on tenure.
facts.citation: P.R. Laws Ann. tit. 29 § 185a et seq. (Ley 80-1976, as amended by Ley 4-2017)
facts.sourceAgency: Puerto Rico Depto. del Trabajo y Recursos Humanos
facts.notes: VERIFY the current mesada formula (changed by Ley 4-2017).

facts.summary: Covered employers must pay eligible employees a statutory annual Christmas bonus — a Puerto Rico-specific requirement with no federal equivalent.
facts.citation: P.R. Laws Ann. tit. 29 § 501 et seq. (Ley 148-1969, as amended)
facts.sourceAgency: Puerto Rico Depto. del Trabajo y Recursos Humanos
facts.notes: VERIFY eligibility thresholds and amount (amended by Ley 4-2017).

facts.summary: Claims for unpaid wages/overtime in Puerto Rico generally have a 3-year statute of limitations.
facts.sourceAgency: Puerto Rico Depto. del Trabajo y Recursos Humanos
facts.notes: VERIFY the limitations period and cite.
